<b>Pilgrim Hornflies</b> are Pilgrim [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are short, flying pilgrims that use their long horn to attack.<ref>Pilgrim Hornfly [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Short pilgrim that uses their long horn to launch upon threats."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pilgrim Hornflies idly hop around when Hornet is not in range, turning around when they reach an edge or a wall.<br>
Once Hornet is close enough, they hover in the air briefly at the height of their next jump before diving diagonally down towards her, bouncing once before getting back up.

Their attack and contact both deal {{Damage|1}}.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pilgrim Hornflies have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
1 Pilgrim Hornfly can be found consistently in south-eastern [[Far Fields]], with another being found in a secret room in the eastern parts of the [[Wormways]].

In [[Bonegrave]], 1-2 Pilgrim Hornflies can appear as one of the possible enemy spawn variants upon revisiting the area. Inside the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]], 2 Pilgrim Hornflies appear as part of the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#Chapel_of_the_Wanderer|gauntlet]].

During Act 3, one Pilgrim Hornfly appears in the west of [[Shellwood]]. They also spawn fighting [[Shakra]] near the [[Bellhart]] exits to Shellwood and [[Greymoor]].
